description: This file implements a JSON encoder and decoder class 'Services_JSON' with associated constants, error handling classes, and utility functions for converting data to and from JSON format. It includes methods for encoding various data types, decoding JSON strings, and handling Unicode conversions.

classes.name: Services_JSON
classes.description: A class providing methods to encode PHP variables into JSON strings and decode JSON strings into PHP variables, with configurable error handling and type options.

classes.name: Services_JSON_Error
classes.description: Error class for handling JSON encoding/decoding errors, extending PEAR_Error if available.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for Services_JSON, sets behavior flags.

methods.name: utf162utf8
methods.description: Converts a UTF-16 character to UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: utf82utf16
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 character to UTF-16 encoding.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a PHP variable into a JSON string.

methods.name: name_value
methods.description: Generates a JSON name-value pair from a key and value.

methods.name: reduce_string
methods.description: Removes comments and whitespace from a JSON string.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a PHP variable.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if a value is a PEAR error or similar.
